name: Env Secrets Conceal
author: Tahr Team
description: Protects sensitive credentials in .env files using Tahr's Virtual Text Conceal engine to mask secret tokens with dots and reveal them on hover

mask_char.description: Character used for concealing sensitive secret values

mask_length.description: Fixed number of mask characters to display in place of secret

reveal_on_cursor.description: Temporarily unmask value when cursor is located on the key-value line
